P2P baby monitor: WebRTC (PeerJS), Vite + TypeScript. Baby Station streams camera/mic; Parent Station receives stream.

Files: `src/main.ts` routing/URL state; `src/baby-station.ts` camera/mic; `src/parent-station.ts` video/audio/motion/reconnection; `src/motion-detection.ts` frame differencing; `src/utils.ts` wake lock/media; `src/dictionary.ts` room IDs; `src/style.css`; `vite.config.ts`; `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`; colocated `src/*.test.ts`; Playwright `tests/`.

Each station is self-contained with `init*` function returning `CleanupHandle`. All stations MUST return `{ cleanup: () => void }` for proper teardown
Use `querySelectorOrThrow()` - never silently fail on missing DOM
Always request on station init, release in cleanup
Never leave MediaStream tracks running after cleanup
Never use `querySelector` without null check (use `querySelectorOrThrow`)
Don't hardcode PeerJS peer
